ei.title: Request to Recommend Students for Fair
ei.subject: 9월_2023 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Request to Recommend Students for Fair

fullPassage: Dear Professor Sanchez, My name is Ellis Wight, and I'm the director of the Alexandria Science Museum. We are holding a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The goal of the fair is to encourage them to be interested in science through guided experiments. We are looking for college students who can help with the experiments during the event. I am contacting you to ask you to recommend some students from the chemistry department at your college who you think are qualified for this job. With their help, I'm sure the participants will have a great experience. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Sincerely, Ellis Wight

questions.passage: Dear Professor Sanchez, My name is Ellis Wight, and I'm the director of the Alexandria Science Museum. We are (A)[attending / holding] a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The goal of the fair is to (B)[encourage / discourage] them to be interested in science through guided experiments. We are looking for college students who can help with the experiments during the event. I am contacting you to ask you to recommend some students from the chemistry department at your college who you think are (C)[qualified / incompetent] for this job. With their help, I'm sure the participants will have a great experience. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Sincerely, Ellis Wight
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① holding(개최하다) — encourage(북돋우다) — qualified(자격 있는): 원문 일치
❌ ② attending(참석하다)은 박람회를 여는 주최자 문맥에 부적절
❌ ③ discourage(단념시키다)는 encourage(북돋우다)의 반의어
❌ ④ incompetent(무능한)은 qualified(자격 있는)의 반의어

questions.passage: Dear Professor Sanchez, My name is Ellis Wight, and I'm the director of the Alexandria Science Museum. We are holding a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The (A)[obstacle / goal] of the fair is to encourage them to be interested in science through (B)[guided / unsupervised] experiments. We are looking for college students who can help with the experiments during the event. I am contacting you to ask you to recommend some students from the chemistry department at your college who you think are qualified for this job. With their help, I'm sure the (C)[participants / observers] will have a great experience. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Sincerely, Ellis Wight
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① obstacle(장애물)은 박람회의 목표라는 문맥에 부적절
❌ ② unsupervised(감독 없는)는 안내된 실험이라는 문맥에 부적절
❌ ③ observers(관찰자)는 실험에 직접 참여하는 참가자 문맥에 부적절
✅ ④ goal(목표) — guided(안내를 받는) — participants(참가자): 원문 일치

questions.passage: Dear Professor Sanchez, My name is Ellis Wight, and I'm the director of the Alexandria Science Museum. We are holding a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The goal of the fair is to encourage them to be (A)[bored / interested] in science through guided experiments. We are looking for college students who can help with the experiments during the event. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① bored(지루해하는)는 과학에 흥미를 갖게 한다는 문맥에 부적절

❌ ③ criticize(비판하다)는 학생을 추천해 달라는 문맥에 부적절
❌ ④ terrible(끔찍한)은 좋은 경험을 기대하는 문맥에 부적절

questions.passage:
(A) We are holding a Chemistry <u>Fair</u> for local middle school students this October.

(B) The referee tried hard to keep the match <u>fair</u> for both teams.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 fair의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) Chemistry Fair = 화학 박람회(행사) / (B) keep the match fair = 경기를 공정하게 유지하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (B)는 '공정한'이어야 함
✅ ② (A) 박람회 — (B) 공정한: 정확
❌ ③ (A)는 '박람회'여야 함
❌ ④ (A)는 '박람회'여야 함

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"to suggest that someone or something is good enough or suitable for a particular job or purpose"

det.korean: 누군가나 무언가가 어떤 일이나 목적에 적합하다고 제안하다 → recommend
det.analysis:
❌ ① criticize: 비판하다
❌ ② ignore: 무시하다
❌ ③ replace: 대체하다
✅ ④ recommend: 추천하다(정의 일치)

questions.passage: We are holding a Chemistry Fair for local middle school students on Saturday, October 28. The goal of the fair is to encourage them to be __________ (interest) in science through guided experiments.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 정답: interested. 「be interested in ~」은 '~에 관심이 있다'라는 뜻으로, 사람의 감정을 나타낼 때는 과거분사형 interested를 씁니다.

questions.passage: With their help, I'm sure the participants will have a great experience. I look forward to __________ (hear) from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: 정답: hearing. 「look forward to」의 to는 전치사라서 뒤에는 동사원형이 아니라 동명사(-ing)가 옵니다. 그래서 hear → hearing.
